lina: FYI mkdocs linkcheck failed on the latest docs build, root is a broken anchor in the SDK reference page /sdk/client -> anchor generated as sdkclientcreate vs expected createclient :grimace: samir: yeah i ran the local linkcheck, looks like codefence inline identifier `Client.create` is being slugified differently across mkdocs vs docusaurus :thinking_face: tj: are we mixing mkdocs and docusaurus outputs? which pipeline hit CI? maria: mkdocs site (mkdocs-material) is the canonical build. docusaurus is old staging but some examples were migrated from docusaurus and kept inline header hints that mkdocs slugify changes. lina: short term: can someone open a tiny PR to add an explicit anchor id to the heading so linkcheck passes? example: `### Creating a client {#creating-a-client}` or HTML `

Creating a client

` samir: on it. I'll do the MDX -> markdown tweak and push. want me to target the example that lives at docs/sdk/html-client.md line ~120? tj: yes that's the one. also add a short note in the PR description explaining the slugify mismatch so we don't revert later. samir: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4923 - small patch, added explicit id and updated the internal link to `#client-create`. includes a unit for linkcheck locally. maria: nice. does this affect any cross-version anchors for older SDK examples? if we change ids we might break archived links. lina: good point. keep the old anchor as a redirect fragment if possible. mkdocs supports redirects via plugin but that's heavier. alternative: add both anchors, e.g., `

Creating a client

` so both slugs resolve. samir: i added a second empty anchor with the legacy slug to preserve backlinks. code diff includes: ```html

Creating a client

``` should be harmless. tj: thanks. can you also run `npm run docs:linkcheck` and paste the failing line in the PR? helps reviewers. samir: pasted linkcheck output in PR description, snippet: ``` ERROR: Broken link /sdk/client#Client.create -> 404 (anchor not found) ``` fixed now locally. maria: quick QA: please run the preview deploy so we can click through. samir: kicking off a Netlify preview (build id 98765). deploy-bot: Netlify deploy queued for branch docs/anchor-fix (site: docs-site) — build 98765 started lina: while we're here, noticed a handful of codeblock language tags are `js` vs `javascript` and mkdocs lint warns. can we standardize in same PR? small sed fix? tj: separate tiny commit pls so blame is clear. also add a changelog note under docs/CHANGES.md that said "anchor + snippet tidy". samir: split commits: 1) anchor + blank legacy anchor, 2) codeblock tag normalization, 3) CHANGES.md entry. pushed. maria: preview is live: https://deploy-preview-98765--docs.redwoodinference.com/sdk/client — I clicked the client section and anchors work :tada: lina: awesome. merging after a quick LGTM from docs. docsbot: automated check: linkcheck ✅, markdownlint ✅, accessibility checks ⚠️ (color contrast on example table) — see warnings in PR checks tj: we should file a follow-up to fix the contrast then. not blocking this merge unless it's severe. maria: noted. created issue #1307 for contrast fix and linked in PR. samir: merged into main. thanks all. lina: great. follow-up: can somebody add a note to the docs contribution guide about preserving legacy anchors when migrating examples? small paragraph under "anchors and links". tj: I'll draft it. short blurb + an example showing dual anchor pattern. maria: thanks everyone. closing thread. :wave:
